verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page says users can ask Copilot in natural language for insights into public and private repositories and to open a new pull request (docs-6). It also says Copilot code review can analyze pull requests on the phone (docs-4, docs-13), which covers both readings of "open pull requests". Missing for 10: in-depth documentation beyond marketing one-liners, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Copilot chat in the mobile app (the community feedback predates Copilot and doesn't address it).
